replay: Use an isolated copy of demo/4D Invoice; never open or modify the supplied empty data file.
Install the five retained .4dm capture helpers only into that copy's Project/Sources/Methods and validate them through 4dlsp.
Place capture-window.py and task-windows.swift under the isolated copy's output directory.
Place one job from this manifest in the isolated copy's capture-job.json; create its output directory.

Use the retained isolated Data/capture.4DD for the same invoice values. A newly created data file reruns FillData and produces different random invoices; it cannot reproduce those values byte-for-byte.
With macOS Screen Recording permission enabled, run .venv/bin/python <isolated-copy>/output/capture-window.py.
The script captures only the matching window owned by the newly launched 4D process, then signals that process to quit.
Compare the native image and recorded state with the reviewed figures; do not assume another platform/theme/build produces identical pixels.
